references.text: The parable of the talents shares similarities with Mark 13:34 in that it concerns a master who travels away and entrusts his property to his servants, expecting them to manage what they have been given responsibility for.
The parable of the minas resembles Mark 13:34 in that a man of high rank travels to a distant country to receive royal authority and gives his servants tasks during his absence.
The prophet Isaiah speaks of watchmen on Jerusalem's walls who must not remain silent, which may recall the call to stay awake in Mark 13:34.
The psalm highlights the importance of the Lord watching over the city, which can be associated with the role of the watchman in Mark 13:34.
